description: This file provides date formatting helper functions used for converting ISO date strings into human-readable formats, specifically 'DD MMM YYYY' and date ranges in that format. The functions are designed for use across preview and PPT export features within the presentation builder project.

methods.name: formatDdMmmYyyy(dateStr)
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) into 'DD MMM YYYY' format, returning an empty string for invalid or null inputs.

methods.name: formatDateRangeDdMmmYyyy(startDateStr, endDateStr)
methods.description: Formats a pair of ISO date strings into a range 'DD MMM YYYY – DD MMM YYYY', returning an empty string if either date is invalid.
